name: research-mapping
description: Read the formal Research Mapping graph and the governance record of one submission through the permissioned management MCP. Read-only: submitting, reviewing and formalizing candidates require the Owner-side capability set and are not exposed here.

tools.name: get_formal_mapping
tools.description: Read the current formal Research Mapping graph for a domain. Requires the read or centre capability.

output.status: string (available when a formal revision exists; otherwise a failure status)
output.published_by: string (the principal that approved this revision; null on failure)
output.documents: array of graph records (only present when status is available)

tools.name: get_formal_mapping_at_revision
tools.description: Read the exact formal Research Mapping snapshot pinned by a specific formal_revision_id (historical activated revision), using the same consistency gates as the current pointer read. Requires the read or centre capability.

output.status: string (available when a formal revision exists; otherwise a failure status)
output.published_by: string (the principal that approved this revision; null on failure)
output.documents: array of graph records (only present when status is available)

tools.name: list_candidates
tools.description: Read the candidate record associated with a submission. Requires the read or centre capability.

output.candidate: object | null (submission + proposal + candidate commit identities; null when the submission does not exist)
